A standard fine-grained classifier trained on object categories (e.g., species, car models) cannot distinguish material properties like transparency or wood grain texture; this requires a material-specific model or a VLM with reasoning capabilities. The plan fails to utilize the `perceptual_quality_auditor` or a VLM-based approach for the complex material and spatial reasoning tasks (Atom 3, Atom 5), relying instead on mismatched tools.
